Contact us

If something isn't working, or you need a job letter and the service can't help you, contact the Ministry of Education's Personnel Department.

Ministry of Education Transformation

'Elsie Payne Complex'
Constitution Road
St. Michael BB 11124
Barbados, W.I.

Telephone: (246) 535-0600

Common reasons people get in touch

  • The service can't find a record for your employee ID. Your record may not yet be on the system.
  • Your details on the generated letter are out of date. Your school's personnel officer can update them.
  • A bank or retailer can't verify a letter you've shared.
